notes: 2026 interim figures are unaudited. Do not plot annual and half-year totals as consecutive equal-length periods.
Selected compute commitments have different terms and contractual scopes. They are not current expenses or a complete aggregate commitment total.
Customer thresholds overlap. Counts labelled approximately or more than must retain their qualifiers.
Gross margin is calculated from the functional cost-of-revenue disclosure; channel partner costs are largely reported in sales and marketing.
Anonymous customer shares below the 10 percent disclosure threshold are represented by null, not zero.
Top-five quarterly shares are complements of the reported outside-top-five share and are approximate; Q2 is not disclosed here.
Cloud-channel dollar revenue is calculated from rounded reported shares and must be labelled approximate.

customer_concentration.null_meaning: Less than 10 percent; not zero, not missing revenue
customer_concentration.customer_identities: Undisclosed; do not infer from anonymous labels

cloud_channel.notes: Cloud marketplaces are distribution and billing channels, not a single end customer. Revenue shares are period flows; receivables shares are date-specific balances.

geographic_revenue.definition: Determined by customer billing address, not nationality or final user location

contracted_revenue.notes: RPO includes deferred revenue; these amounts are not additive. RPO is not cash received or a total revenue forecast.

offering_and_lockup.null_meaning: Blank in this preliminary S-1; not zero
offering_and_lockup.day_zero: Date of final prospectus, not 2026-10-26 filing date
offering_and_lockup.percentage_denominator: Relevant cohort holder baseline lock-up securities, not company outstanding shares or public float

employee_nonfounder_officer_director_con.baseline: End of calendar month preceding prospectus month
employee_nonfounder_officer_director_con.remaining_lockup_ends: Earlier of Q1 2027 earnings second full trading day and close of prospectus date +180 days

certain_other_holders_180day.remaining_lockup_ends: Earlier of Q1 2027 earnings second full trading day and close of prospectus date +180 days

certain_large_holders_365day.remaining_lockup_ends: Earlier of Q3 2027 earnings second full trading day and close of prospectus date +365 days

seven_cofounders.baseline: End of calendar month preceding prospectus month
seven_cofounders.remaining_lockup_ends: Earlier of Q3 2027 earnings second full trading day and close of prospectus date +365 days

qualifications: Transfers remain subject to applicable securities resale and other restrictions.

valuation_analysis.definition: P/S uses equity value divided by revenue, not enterprise value. Hypothetical market values are not official IPO pricing.

five_year_scenario.notes: Illustrative revenue needed to support unchanged hypothetical equity value at an assumed future P/E and net margin; not a return forecast and excludes dilution, discounting and share-price changes.

valuation_analysis.source: S-1 page 3, page 68 and quarterly results page 158

commitment_footnotes.notes: Two commitment categories are disclosed separately and not aggregated here. June figures are not the latest total of all October contracts. Leases not yet commenced have contractual conditions; amounts are undiscounted. Recognized lease liabilities have a different scope and are discounted.
